audit.whatIsWrong: The page consistently calls Olaf's axe throw his 'E' and credits it with true damage, and credits Ragnarok with true damage. Both are wrong slots.
audit.why: Undertow (Q): 1000 range, 9s flat, throws an axe that reduces Armor and Move Speed, cooldown RESETS if he picks the axe up — no true damage. Reckless Swing (E): 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s, true damage to the target and to himself. Ragnarok (R): 100/90/80s, passive armour and MR, active immunity to disables while he keeps attacking — no true damage of its own.
audit.corrected: Undertow is the armour-shred/slow with the pickup reset; Reckless Swing is the melee true damage; Ragnarok is CC-immunity plus resistances. Every reference re-pointed to the right ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Olaf / Olaf / Skill x5. The packet chart over 2200 games reads Olaf / Mordekaiser / Olaf / Olaf / Mordekaiser / Olaf / Olaf, and the win rate is 47.91%.
audit.why: The page's own prose already matches the packet: whys[1] is 'Your Q+W spike arrives', whys[2] and whys[3] hand 3 and 4-5 to Olaf, whys[4] is the Realm window, whys[5] and whys[6] give the item phases to Olaf.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group: Mordekaiser, Olaf, Olaf, Mordekaiser, Olaf, Olaf.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item and 2+ item rows were written as Mordekaiser spikes.
audit.why: Berserker Rage gives attack speed and life steal scaling on missing health, so a bruiser-item Olaf out-grinds Indestructible's heal. Your only real second-half spike is Realm of Death (140/120/100s, 650 range) with Ragnarok already burned.
audit.corrected: Your spikes: level 2-3 (Q+W) and level 6. His: level 1, level 3 through 5, and every item after the first.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Stack pure HP' but its body was copy-pasted boilerplate about whiffing Q.
audit.why: Reckless Swing is true damage, so neither armour nor MR answers it; the counterplay is Grievous Wounds against his life steal.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to say resistances do not answer true damage and anti-heal does.

notes: The dominant defect here was slot confusion, not the chart: every content string called the axe throw his 'E' and gave it true damage, and gave Ragnarok true damage as well. Riot's text is unambiguous — Undertow (Q, 1000 range, 9s, resets on pickup) shreds Armor and Move Speed; Reckless Swing (E, 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s) is the true damage and costs him health; Ragnarok (R, 100/90/80s) is passive armour/MR plus immunity to disables while attacking. The chart was also wrong in 6 of 7 rows against a 2200-game packet and is proposed as one atomic paired group. Mordekaiser Q's 'grounding' flag is a parse artifact of 'smashes the ground' and was not asserted; Olaf Q carries the same false flag from 'throws an axe into the ground' and was likewise not asserted. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Ragnarok's disable immunity prevents Realm of Death from pulling him in, or only breaks CC once inside.
